posts.description: Former elite soldier turned crook Snake Plissken (Kurt Russell) flies into Manhattan. posts.description: The meet-cute for the doomed lovers of 1946's Leave Her To Heaven takes place on the train to New Mexico, where Ellen Berent (Gene Tierney) catches the eye of author Richard Harland (Cornel Wilde). It's not Ellen's astonishing beauty that he notices first, but his own face – she's reading a copy of his latest novel.
